command: set -e; echo ENVIRONMENT; hostname; echo TAILSCALE_BINARY; command -v tailscale || true; echo NET_DEVICES; ls -1 /sys/class/net | head -30; echo CONNECTIVITY; if command -v tailscale >/dev/null 2>&1; then tailscale status --json 2>/dev/null | python3 -c 'import sys,json;x=json.load(sys.stdin);print({"backend":x.get("BackendState"),"self_dns":(x.get("Self") or {}).get("DNSName")})' || true; else echo NO_TAILSCALE_CLIENT; fi; echo GRID10; test -e /workspace/frankgrid10-organ/run/heartbeat.json && python3 -c 'import json;print({k:v for k,v in json.load(open("/workspace/frankgrid10-organ/run/heartbeat.json")).items() if k in ("status","runtime_epoch_id")})'; echo END
